status: design fixed before this execution; retrospective inputs and results already known from v22
question: Separate structural eligibility and quality policy contributions to observer contrast bounds over unchanged finite raw-read universes.
data: All 15 unique frozen streams, 429812 raw reads; primary results three nominal CFB preparations against mock/untreated.

policies.structural_only: Original ACGT-only observer structural/classification rules, no numerical quality gate.
policies.own_meanQ30: Original arithmetic mean Phred>=30 over each own outer span including anchors.
policies.common_raw_meanQ30: Arithmetic mean Phred>=30 over original entire raw sequence; fixed per-read across observers and trims. Gate failures remain U within original N.
policies.common_and_own_meanQ30: Intersection of common original-read and observer own-window gates; reports overlap explicitly.

contrasts: Complete [L_t-H_c,H_t-L_c] in Fraction; primary PE-mock and secondary PE-untreated; no donor pairing or causal inference.
decomposition: Gap(B,A) in contrast lower bound = difference treated E/N + difference control NE/N. Own-quality gap = structural gap + difference of quality penalties. Algebraic policy decomposition, not causal biological mediation.
validation: Match original ACGT_only and meanQ30 counts exactly for every run/event/observer and trim0/8.
Verify original compressed and sequence-quality hashes and N.
Check that quality gated labels are U or equal ungated label; common gates never alter raw N.
Compatible unions require zero resolved conflicts; fail explicitly otherwise.
limits: Quality is arithmetic mean of Phred, not average base-call error probability.
Full-read common mask can itself select products; it is a diagnostic held equal across observers, not a calibrated truth mask.
Removing quality gates assumes accepted labels valid and does not prove greater accuracy.
Structural differences include anchors, unique motifs, alphabet and nesting; only literal prefix/end diagnostics specifically support a read-end geometry mechanism.
No new data, biological experiments, external generalization or publication.
